usage: music-tagger <command> [options]

Fix album tags using MusicBrainz.

commands:
  read           Read album tags and durations as JSON.
  toc            Parse rip artifacts for TOC / disc ID.
  mb             MusicBrainz query commands.
  match          Score candidates by duration match.
  diff           Compute tag diff against a MusicBrainz release.
  write-tags     Apply tag changes from a diff JSON.
  write-ratings  Write rating tags to audio files.
  write-stats    Write ratings and play counts from a snapshot.
  path-for       Compute library destination paths.
  copy           Copy files to library per a placement plan.
  art            Fetch or install cover art for an album.
  nd             Navidrome commands.
  scan           Generate a checklist of albums needing attention.
  checklist      Show the next album, or mark one done, skipped, or reopened.
  candidates     Show MusicBrainz candidates for an album.
  tag            Apply tags from a chosen MusicBrainz release.
  apply          Run tag, art, genre, rename, and replaygain on an album.
  place          Copy a finished album into the library.
  genre          Set or show the genre meta-grouping tag.
  lyrics         Inspect, look up, or write lyric sidecars for an album.
  lyrics-batch   Backfill lyrics across a library and save tracks that need a decision.
  lyrics-decide  Show saved lyric options and record a choice or skip for each track.
  lock           Lock fields so `tag` keeps them, or show locks.
  unlock         Unlock fields so `tag` can change them.
  rename         Rename files to 'NN. Title.ext' from tags.
  replaygain     Compute and write ReplayGain 2.0 tags.
  rip            Rip a CD to FLAC with bootstrap tags.

Run 'music-tagger <command> --help' for command-specific help.
